notes: No remote command channel. The Dead Matter dedicated server (Unreal Engine 4, DeadMatterServer, Steam app 2584780; game app 2184150, formerly the 575440 closed alpha) ships no RCON listener, no admin HTTP/REST API, and no documented stdin console: the only network ports it opens are the game ports (UDP/TCP 7777 and 7778) and the Steam A2S query port (UDP 27016). Basis: the community config reference at johnnyguitarFP/deadmatterdedisetup enumerates every documented Engine.ini and Game.ini key and contains no rcon/enable/port/password setting of any kind; the winglessraven Dead Matter Server Manager - a tool built specifically to run these servers - drives them purely by editing ini files and controlling the process, and exposes no list/kick/ban; hosting write-ups (IONOS, Survival Servers, the Steam dedicated-server tutorial) likewise describe ini-only administration. Dead Matter DOES have admin commands, but they are CLIENT-side: a player whose Steam64 ID is listed under Admins= or SuperAdmins= in [/Script/DeadMatter.DMGameSession] in Game.ini types them into the in-game chat (press Y), e.g. /kick, /ban, /banid, /unban, /banlistex, /kickall. They require a logged-in admin character in the world and cannot be sent by a server manager, so they are deliberately NOT recorded as commands here - recording them would ship buttons that send nothing. There is likewise no listPlayers over any pipe. Moderation identity is the Steam64 ID (that is what Admins=, SuperAdmins= and +Whitelist= take, and what the in-game /banid takes); playerId records it for manual entry only. The MOTD is the Game.ini key MOTD= and the whitelist is WhitelistActive= plus +Whitelist= entries - both config, not commands, and both need a restart. No ban-list file path is documented, so no banList block is recorded. Caveat: no official developer documentation for the dedicated server could be found anywhere - the publisher has published none - so this is a negative established from four independent third-party sources rather than an explicit vendor statement. If Dead Matter ever adds RCON this file must be revisited.
